definition.objective: mean over admitted curves of 75% mean four section RRMS + 25% worst section RRMS
definition.improvement_rule: objective delta < -1e-4 and no section worsens by >0.02
definition.recommendation_rule: at one probed multiplier, at least min_hits distinct devices improve in the same parameter/polarity/direction group and no probed device of that polarity regresses; the largest such multiplier is the supported expansion
